# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 13
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 13

---

*[Paradise: the garden of the righteous. Martyrs, the generous poor, David.]*

1. We went to a great garden, glorious and beautiful, full of fair trees and most fragrant herbs.

2. A great fragrance filled it, with fruit-bearing trees and springs of water and rivers flowing through it.

3. The fruit of the trees was most beautiful and sweet; flowers of every kind were present, and the fragrance of the garden was surpassing all things.

4. The light of that place was seven times brighter than the light of the sun.

5. Those who were there were clothed in the garments of the angels of light; their clothing was like the light, and they praised God with a great voice.

6. I, Peter, asked the Lord: "Who are these?"

7. He said to me: "These are your brothers — the righteous ones who received the crown of martyrdom."

8. I said to him: "Lord, where are those who shed their blood for you?"

9. He showed me a great place, full of beautiful fruit-bearing trees, of spices, and of trees of healing. The fruit of those trees was most fragrant and beautiful.

10. The roots of those trees reached down to the spring of life, and they were rejoicing and praising God.

11. I asked: "What did these do?"

12. He said: "These are those who gave all they had to the poor, who loved God and did not love the world, who did not fear the torments of men."

13. He showed me a high and glorious place, brighter than the sun, and there I saw David with his harp, praising God with a joyful voice.

---
*LOGOS note: The "trees of healing" (v.9) echo Revelation 22:2 (the tree of life whose leaves are for the healing of the nations). The "spring of life" (v.10) echoes Rev 21:6 and 22:1. The paradise vision is saturated with Revelation imagery, confirming the APE's close relationship to the Johannine tradition.*
